text.zh: 你现在可能正站着或坐着，觉得自己没在用力。接下来看看有多少块肌肉正在替你顶着。
text.en: Right now you are probably standing or sitting, feeling like you are doing nothing at all. Let us count the muscles holding you up anyway.

text.zh: 先看背后。竖脊肌沿脊柱两侧从骨盆一直排到后脑，只要你没趴下，它就没停过。
text.en: Start at the back. The erector spinae run alongside the spine from pelvis to skull, and unless you are lying face down, they never stop.

text.zh: 臀大肌是人体最有力的肌肉之一。它一收缩就把髋伸直，人才不会一直折在腰上。
text.en: The gluteus maximus is among the most powerful muscles you have. Each contraction straightens the hip, keeping you from folding at the waist.

text.zh: 大腿后面的腘绳肌跨过髋和膝两个关节，一头拉住骨盆，一头拉住小腿，两边同时管。
text.en: Behind the thigh, the hamstrings span two joints at once — anchoring the pelvis at one end and the lower leg at the other, minding both.

text.zh: 小腿深处的比目鱼肌最不起眼却最要紧：站着时它一收一放，像挤海绵一样把血往上推。
text.en: Deep in the calf, the soleus is the least conspicuous and the most essential: standing, it squeezes and releases, pushing blood upward like a sponge.

text.zh: 它外面覆着腓肠肌，就是小腿肚的那道隆起。踮脚、蹬地、跳起来，爆发力主要来自它。
text.en: Over it lies the gastrocnemius, the bulge you can see in the calf. Rising on your toes, pushing off, jumping — the explosive power comes mostly from here.

text.zh: 两块肌肉的力都汇进跟腱，全身最粗的一根。每走一步，它都在把身体弹向前方。
text.en: The force of both muscles funnels into the calcaneal tendon, the thickest in the body. With every step it springs you forward again.

text.zh: 小腿前面还有胫骨前肌在反向工作，把脚背勾起来——没有它，走路时脚尖会拖地。
text.en: At the front of the shin, the tibialis anterior works the other way, lifting the top of the foot — without it, your toes would scuff the ground.

text.zh: 所以「站着不动」根本不是静止，而是一整套肌肉不停地微调。累，是有道理的。
text.en: So standing still is not stillness at all, but a whole set of muscles endlessly making small corrections. No wonder it tires you out.
